literal: In the seventh month, Empress He of Yong’an died.
idiomatic: July: Empress He of Yong’an passed away.

literal: In Yixi first year, third month, day Renchen, the moon covered the Left Law Enforcer.
idiomatic: Yixi one, third month, renchen: the Moon occulted the Left Law Enforcer.

literal: The prognostication was the same as above.
idiomatic: The same gloss applied.

literal: On day Dingyou, the moon covered the front star of the Heart.
idiomatic: Dingyou: the Moon occulted the Heart’s forward star.

literal: The prognostication states: "Yu Province will have calamity."
idiomatic: The omen targets Yu region.

literal: The Great White transgressed the Eastern Well.
idiomatic: Venus crossed the Eastern Well.

literal: The prognostication states: "Qin will have arms."
idiomatic: Foretells Qin-zone warfare.

literal: On day Gengchen in the seventh month, the Great White was seen in daytime, in the Wings and Chariot.
idiomatic: July, gengchen: Venus shone by day through Wings and Chariot.

literal: The prognostication states: "Ministers will be strong; Jing Province will have arms and mourning."
idiomatic: Powerful ministers and Jingzhou war and funerals.

literal: On day Dingsi in the eighth month, the moon transgressed the first star of the Dipper.
idiomatic: August, dingsi: the Moon crossed the Dipper’s first star.

literal: The prognostication states: "Under Heaven there will be arms."
idiomatic: General war spreads.

literal: One gloss says: "Great ministers will grieve."
idiomatic: Senior officials face sorrow.

literal: On day Jiazi in the ninth month, Mars transgressed Shao Wei.
idiomatic: September, jiazi: Mars crossed Shao Wei.

literal: The prognostication states: "Recluses will be executed."
idiomatic: Hermit scholars face execution.

literal: On day Gengyin, Mars transgressed the Right Law Enforcer.
idiomatic: Gengyin: Mars crossed the Right Law Enforcer.

literal: On day Guimao, Mars transgressed the Left Law Enforcer.
idiomatic: Guimao: Mars crossed the Left Law Enforcer.

literal: The prognostications were all the same as above.
idiomatic: Glosses matched prior entries.

literal: On day Bingxu in the eleventh month, the Great White transgressed the Hook-and-Hasp.
idiomatic: November, bingxu: Venus crossed the Hook-and-Hasp.

literal: The prognostication states: "Throat-and-tongue will grieve."
idiomatic: Spokesmen and advisors face ruin.

literal: On day Jimao in the twelfth month, Jupiter transgressed the Celestial River.
idiomatic: December, jimao: Jupiter crossed the Celestial River.

literal: The prognostication states: "There will be military turmoil; river fords will not be open."
idiomatic: War chaos chokes the waterways.

literal: In the eleventh month, Inspector of Jing Province Wei Yongzhi died.
idiomatic: November: Jing inspector Wei Yongzhi passed away.

literal: In the second year’s second month, Sima Guofan and others attacked and took Yiyang.
idiomatic: Second year, February: Sima Guofan’s faction seized Yiyang.

literal: In the fourth month, Yao Xing campaigned against Lord of Chouchi Yang Sheng and drove him off.
idiomatic: April: Yao Xing struck Yang Sheng of Chouchi and repulsed him.

literal: In the ninth month, Inspector of Yi Province Sima Rongqi was killed by his adjutant Yang Chengzu.
idiomatic: September: Yi inspector Sima Rongqi fell to adjutant Yang Chengzu’s blade.

literal: In the third year’s twelfth month, Minister of Education and Yangzhou Inspector Wang Mi died.
idiomatic: Third year, December: Wang Mi, Minister of Education and Yangzhou inspector, died.

literal: In the fourth year’s first month, Grand Guardian and Prince of Wuling, Zun, died.
idiomatic: Fourth year, first month: Grand Guardian Prince Zun of Wuling died.

literal: In the third month, Left Director Kong Anguo died.
idiomatic: March: Left Director Kong Anguo passed away.

literal: From this time government lay with Liu Yu; the ruler merely folded his hands.
idiomatic: Afterward real power sat with Liu Yu while the emperor ruled in name only.

literal: In the second year’s second month, the Great White transgressed the Southern Dipper.
idiomatic: Second year, February: Venus crossed the Southern Dipper.

literal: The prognostication states: "Arms will arise."
idiomatic: War stirs.

literal: On day Jichou, the moon transgressed the rear star of the Heart.
idiomatic: Jichou: the Moon crossed the Heart’s rear star.

literal: The prognostication states: "Yu Province will have calamity."
idiomatic: Yu region again bears the omen.

literal: On day Guichou in the fourth month, the moon transgressed the western upper general of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
idiomatic: April, guichou: the Moon crossed the enclosure’s western upper general.

literal: On day Jiwei, the moon transgressed the second southern star of the Chamber.
idiomatic: Jiwei: the Moon crossed the Chamber’s second south star.

literal: On day Yichou, Jupiter transgressed the Celestial River.
idiomatic: Yichou: Jupiter crossed the Celestial River.

literal: The prognostication states: "There will be military turmoil; river fords will not be open."
idiomatic: River blockages and mutiny follow.

literal: On day Guiwei in the fifth month, the moon transgressed the left Horn.
idiomatic: May, guiwei: the Moon crossed the Horn’s left star.

literal: The prognostication states: "The left general will die; under Heaven there will be arms."
idiomatic: The left commander dies while war engulfs the realm.

literal: On day Renyin, Mars transgressed the Root.
idiomatic: Renyin: Mars crossed the Root.

literal: The prognostication states: "The Root is the lodging palace; the ruler will be anxious."
idiomatic: The Root as palace seat means the sovereign faces dread.

literal: On day Gengwu in the sixth month, Mars transgressed the second northern star of the Chamber.
idiomatic: June, gengwu: Mars crossed the Chamber’s second north star.

literal: On day Guihai in the eighth month, Mars transgressed the fifth star of the Southern Dipper.
idiomatic: August, guihai: Mars crossed the Dipper’s fifth star.

literal: On day Dingsi, it transgressed the Establishment stars.
idiomatic: Dingsi: Mars crossed the Establishment asterism.

literal: The prognostication states: "There will be arms."
idiomatic: Plain war omen.

literal: On day Renwu in the ninth month, Mars transgressed the Weeping star and also transgressed the Sobbing star.
idiomatic: September, renwu: Mars crossed both Weeping and Sobbing stars.

literal: In that year’s second month, day Jiaxu, Sima Guofan and others attacked and took Yiyang.
idiomatic: That February, jiaxu, Sima Guofan again seized Yiyang.

literal: Moreover, Murong Chao raided Xu and Yan; in the third year’s first month he again raided Northern Xu Province down to Xiapi.
idiomatic: Murong Chao harried Xu and Yan; third year’s first month he struck Northern Xu as far as Xiapi.

literal: In the twelfth month, Minister of Education Wang Mi died.
idiomatic: December: Minister Wang Mi died.

literal: In the fourth year’s first month, Prince Zun of Wuling died.
idiomatic: Fourth year, first month: Prince Zun of Wuling passed away.

literal: In the fifth year, Murong Chao again raided the Huai north.
idiomatic: Fifth year: Murong Chao returned to scour the north of the Huai.

literal: In the fourth month, Liu Yu’s great army campaigned against him and took Linqu.
idiomatic: April: Liu Yu’s host took Linqu.

literal: He also besieged Guanggu and took it.
idiomatic: He then ringed and stormed Guanggu.

literal: In the third year, first month, day Bingzi, the Great White was seen in daytime, in the Strider.
idiomatic: Third year, first month, bingzi: Venus by day in the Strider (Kui).

literal: On day Gengshen in the second month, the moon covered the rear star of the Heart.
idiomatic: February, gengshen: the Moon occulted the Heart’s rear star.

literal: The prognostication was the same as above.
idiomatic: Same gloss as prior Heart omen.

literal: On day Guiwei in the fifth month, the moon transgressed the left Horn.
idiomatic: May, guiwei: the Moon crossed the left Horn.

literal: On day Jichou, the Great White was seen in daytime, in Orion’s Belt.
idiomatic: Jichou: Venus shone by day in Orion’s Belt.

literal: The prognostication states: "Yi Province will have arms and mourning; ministers will be strong."
idiomatic: Yi region faces war and death while ministers grow bold.

literal: On day Jimao in the eighth month, the Great White transgressed the Left Law Enforcer.
idiomatic: August, jimao: Venus crossed the Left Law Enforcer.

literal: On day Xinmao, Mars transgressed the Left Law Enforcer.
idiomatic: Xinmao: Mars crossed the Left Law Enforcer.

literal: On day Renzi in the ninth month, Mars transgressed the Advancing Worthy star.
idiomatic: September, renzi: Mars crossed Advancing Worthy.

literal: In that year’s eighth month, Liu Jingxuan campaigned against Shu without success and withdrew.
idiomatic: That August Liu Jingxuan’s Shu expedition failed and turned back.

literal: In the fourth year’s third month, Left Director Kong Anguo died.
idiomatic: Fourth year, March: Left Director Kong Anguo died.

literal: In the seventh month, Sima Shufan and others attacked and took Zou Mountain; Lu commandery governor Xu Yong defeated them and drove them off.
idiomatic: July: Sima Shufan seized Zou Mountain until Lu governor Xu Yong routed the band.

literal: Yao Xing sent a host to campaign against Helian Bobo and was greatly defeated by him.
idiomatic: Yao Xing’s army marched on Helian Bobo and was shattered.

literal: In the fifth year, Liu Yu campaigned against Murong Chao and destroyed him.
idiomatic: Fifth year: Liu Yu crushed Murong Chao.

literal: In the fourth year, first month, day Gengzi, Mars transgressed the Celestial Pass.
idiomatic: Fourth year, first month, gengzi: Mars crossed the Celestial Pass.

literal: On day Dingwei in the fifth month, the moon covered the second star of the Dipper.
idiomatic: May, dingwei: the Moon occulted the Dipper’s second star.

literal: On day Renzi, Saturn transgressed the Celestial Granary.
idiomatic: Renzi: Saturn crossed the Celestial Granary.

literal: The prognostication states: "Under Heaven will hunger; granary grain will be little."
idiomatic: Famine empties the state granaries.

literal: On day Jichou in the sixth month, the Great White transgressed the western upper general of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
idiomatic: June, jichou: Venus crossed the western upper general.

literal: On day Yimao it again transgressed the Left Law Enforcer.
idiomatic: Yimao: Venus also crossed the Left Law Enforcer.

literal: On day Wuzi in the tenth month, Mars entered the Feathered Forest.
idiomatic: October, wuzi: Mars entered the Feathered Forest.

literal: The prognostications were all the same as above.
idiomatic: Glosses repeated earlier citations.

literal: In the fifth year, Liu Yu campaigned against Murong Chao; afterward northern and southern armies shuttled without rest.
idiomatic: Fifth year: Liu Yu’s Murong campaign kept north-south logistics in perpetual motion.

literal: In the fifth year, second month, day Jiazi, the moon transgressed the Hairy Head.
idiomatic: Fifth year, second month, jiazi: the Moon crossed the Pleiades.

literal: The prognostication states: "The Hu will not be secure; the Son of Heaven will break the Xiongnu."
idiomatic: Steppe peoples tremble while the court crushes northern raiders.

literal: On day Wuxu in the fifth month, Jupiter entered the Feathered Forest.
idiomatic: May, wuxu: Jupiter entered the Feathered Forest.

literal: On day Renyin in the ninth month, the moon transgressed the Hairy Head.
idiomatic: September, renyin: the Moon crossed the Pleiades.

literal: In the tenth month, Mars transgressed the Root.
idiomatic: October: Mars crossed the Root.

literal: On day Dingyou in the intercalary month, the moon transgressed the Hairy Head.
idiomatic: Leap month, dingyou: the Moon crossed the Pleiades.

literal: On day Xinhai, Mars transgressed the Hook-and-Hasp.
idiomatic: Xinhai: Mars crossed the Hook-and-Hasp.

literal: On day Jisi, the moon covered the great star of the Heart.
idiomatic: Jisi: the Moon occulted Antares.

literal: The prognostication states: "The king finds it ominous."
idiomatic: The sovereign should dread the sign.

literal: In that year’s fourth month, Liu Yu campaigned against Murong Chao.
idiomatic: That April Liu Yu opened the Murong Chao campaign.

literal: In the tenth month, the Prince of Wei, Gui, met assassination and died.
idiomatic: October: Wei prince Tuoba Gui was murdered.

literal: In the sixth year’s fifth month, Lu Xun pressed the suburbs; palace guards donned armor.
idiomatic: Sixth year, May: Lu Xun threatened the capital outskirts and household troops armed.

literal: In the sixth year, third month, day Dingmao, the moon covered the second southern star of the Chamber.
idiomatic: Sixth year, third month, dingmao: the Moon occulted the Chamber’s second south star.

literal: The calamity lies on the secondary minister.
idiomatic: The omen falls on the deputy minister.

literal: On day Jisi, it again covered the fifth star of the Dipper.
idiomatic: Jisi: the Moon again occulted the Dipper’s fifth star.

literal: The prognostication states: "The Dipper governs Wu; Wu lands will have arms arise."
idiomatic: The Dipper ties the sign to Wu and southeast warfare.

literal: The Great White transgressed the Five Feudal Lords.
idiomatic: Venus crossed the Five Feudal Lords.

literal: The prognostication states: "Feudal lords will be executed."
idiomatic: Regional lords face execution.

literal: On day Jiazi in the fifth month, the moon covered the fifth star of the Dipper.
idiomatic: May, jiazi: the Moon occulted the Dipper’s fifth star.

literal: On day Jihai, the moon covered the third star of the Hairy Head.
idiomatic: Jihai: the Moon occulted the Pleiades’ third star.

literal: The prognostication states: "The state will have grief."
idiomatic: National mourning follows.

literal: One gloss says: "There will be a gathering in white."
idiomatic: Another line warns of mass mourning in undyed hemp.

literal: On day Jichou in the sixth month, the moon transgressed the second southern star of the Chamber.
idiomatic: June, jichou: the Moon crossed the Chamber’s second south star.

literal: On day Jiawu, the Great White was seen in daytime.
idiomatic: Jiawu: Venus shone by day.
